name: openbox
description: A extensible toolbox built with Electron
author: openbox

scripts.build: npm run build:plugins && npm run build:app && npm run verify:performance
scripts.build:plugins: node scripts/run-plugin-script.mjs build && node scripts/verify-plugin-renderers.mjs && node scripts/verify-trusted-services.mjs
scripts.package:release: electron-builder --config electron-builder.release.yml --publish never && npm run verify:fuses
scripts.release: npm run build && npm run package:plugins && npm run sign:plugins && npm run verify:release && npm run generate:sbom && npm run package:release && npm run build:release-manifest && npm run release:collect
scripts.release:local: npm run check && npm run build && npm run package:plugins && npm run sign:plugins && npm run verify:release && npm run generate:sbom && npm run package:release && npm run build:release-manifest && npm run release:collect
scripts.release:validate: npm run verify:fuses && npm run smoke:native && npm run smoke:packaged && npm run smoke:installer && node scripts/verify-windows-update-artifacts.mjs release latest.yml && node scripts/build-release-manifest.mjs --require-signature && npm run release:collect && node scripts/generate-release-checksums.mjs artifacts/publish
scripts.release:dir: npm run build && npm run package:dir
scripts.verify:plugins: node scripts/verify-plugin-renderers.mjs && node scripts/verify-trusted-services.mjs && node scripts/verify-plugin-artifacts.mjs
scripts.typecheck:scripts: node --check eslint.config.mjs && node --check scripts/build-plugin-frame-runtime.mjs && node --check scripts/build-plugin-renderer.mjs && node --check scripts/build-release-manifest.mjs && node --check scripts/collect-release-artifacts.mjs && node --check scripts/update-trusted-policy.mjs && node --check scripts/db-recovery-tool.mjs && node --check scripts/verify-clean-checkout.mjs && node --check scripts/verify-plugin-renderers.mjs && node --check scripts/verify-trusted-services.mjs && node --check scripts/verify-performance.mjs && node --check scripts/plugin-artifact-provenance.mjs && node --check scripts/packaged-paths.mjs && node --check scripts/sign-plugin-artifacts.mjs && node --check scripts/verify-plugin-release.mjs && node --check scripts/generate-sbom.mjs && node --check scripts/generate-release-checksums.mjs && node --check scripts/verify-windows-update-artifacts.mjs && node --check scripts/audit-workspaces.mjs && node --check scripts/run-format.mjs && node --check scripts/run-plugin-script.mjs && node --check scripts/clean-plugin-dist.mjs && node --check scripts/clean-all.mjs && node --check scripts/package-plugins.mjs && node --check scripts/verify-plugin-artifacts.mjs && node --check scripts/electron-fuses.mjs && node --check scripts/apply-electron-fuses.mjs && node --check scripts/verify-electron-fuses.mjs && node --check scripts/smoke-native.cjs && node --check scripts/smoke-packaged.mjs && node --check scripts/smoke-windows-installer.mjs && node --check scripts/smoke-release-transition.mjs
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck:node && npm run typecheck:renderer && npm run typecheck:test && npm run typecheck:plugins && npm run typecheck:scripts
scripts.test: npm run test:host && npm run test:plugins && npm run test:supply-chain
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test
